conceptual_change: Introduce a volatility filter by monitoring the 50-period rolling standard deviation of the close location to detect liquidity sweeps, acting as a precondition for mean-reversion signals.
rationale: Liquidity sweeps are often preceded or followed by local volatility expansions. By thresholding the rolling standard deviation of the close_location, we can identify regime changes in market structure where order flow is likely to trap participants, facilitating more robust mean-reversion entries.
